Hymn 255: Carry On
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Alfred M. Durham
Lyricist/Text Author: Ruth May Fox
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 255 titled "Carry On" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Alfred M. Durham and the lyrics were written by Ruth May Fox.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
